name: 城堡之裂界珠 Donjon's Sundering Sphere (BMT)

description.value:
奇物，珍稀（需同調）
這顆彈珠大小的水晶球散發着跨次元能量的光芒。作爲同調該物品的一部分，你將水晶球按壓到你選擇的非魔法近戰武器的刀柄上，將水晶球魔法性地固定在武器上。該武器成爲攻擊檢定和傷害擲骰有+1加值的魔法武器。持握此武器期間，你可以獲得以下好處：
次元錨Dimensional Anchor。你在對抗將你非自願傳送到異次元空間、半位面或另一個存在位面的法術或效應的豁免檢定時具有優勢。
隔離斬Isolating Smite。當你用此武器命中一個生物時，你可以迫使該生物進行一次[[/save ability=cha dc=16]]豁免。若豁免失敗，該生物將被放逐到一個無害的半位面直到其下一回合結束。當被放逐的生物返回時，其重新出現在被放逐前的空間。如果該空間被佔據，則它將出現在最近的未被佔據空間。此項屬性一經使用，直到下次黎明前不能再次使用。
當你結束對球體的同調時，球體會無害地與武器分離，而武器則恢復爲非魔法武器。

This marble-size crystal sphere glows with extraplanar energy.

As part of attuning to this item, you press the crystal sphere to the hilt of a nonmagical melee weapon of your choice, magically attaching the sphere to the weapon. The weapon becomes a magic weapon with a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls. While wielding this weapon, you gain the following benefits:

  • Dimensional Anchor. You have advantage on saving throws against spells or effects that would send you to an extradimensional space, a demiplane, or another plane of existence against your will.

  • Isolating Smite. When you hit a creature with this weapon, you can force the creature to make a [[/save ability=cha dc=16]] saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is banished to a harmless demiplane until the end of its next turn. When the banished creature returns, it reappears in the space it left or the nearest unoccupied space if that space is occupied. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.

When you end your attunement to the sphere, the sphere harmlessly detaches from the weapon, and the weapon reverts to a nonmagical piece of equipment.
